briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: Multiple investigations are underway in Minnesota related to fraud. A $10B benefits fraud investigation is being conducted by the Treasury, and a DOJ probe is looking into a church protest tied to an ICE pastor. These investigations could uncover large-scale fraud schemes and shed light on the involvement of government agencies and ICE. The Minnesota benefits fraud scheme is a high-priority investigation, and the DOJ probe into the church protest is a medium-priority investigation. Next steps include following the money and investigating the circumstances of the church protest.
